summary: Your personal assistant that lives in your texts Discussion | Link
content: Pally is an AI personal assistant you reach over iMessage, RCS, and even on the phone. Unlike other iMessage agents, we connect directly to your iMessage and WhatsApp inboxes, because thats where your life really lives. Pally learns quickly how it can help you, and deploys end-to-end workflows to automate your most manual tasks.
